description: Get a depth heatmap for a Deepstate market: resting order size by price level over time, bucketed and optionally restricted to one side. Each bucket also reports how much of it is covered by a sized order count, so a caller can tell how complete a given level is. Requires a book — call 1s_ds_markets for the list of available book slugs.

book.description: Deepstate market identifier: the 32-byte book_id, or its canonical uppercase slug (e.g. "NVDA-USDG", "DEEP-USDG"). Call 1s_ds_markets first for the full list of available markets and their slugs.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound, RFC 3339 or unix seconds

side.description: Restrict to one side. Default both

to.description: Exclusive upper bound, RFC 3339 or unix seconds. Default: now

name: 1s_ds_depth_history
title: Deepstate Depth History
